Meet Chris

The person behind the work

Hi, I'm Chris. I started Chris Evenson Property Services to provide honest, dependable home repairs with quality workmanship and clear communication. My goal is simple: treat every home like it belongs to a neighbor.

From small repairs to decks, pergolas, and outdoor improvements, I help homeowners across the Upstate keep their property in great shape — one trusted local call, whatever the project.

What I do

Services

From quick fixes to full outdoor builds, here's how I can help around your property.

Home Repair & Handyman Services

Reliable home repairs, maintenance, and small improvement projects.

Outdoor Projects

Pergolas, patios, raised garden beds, landscape improvements, and other custom outdoor projects.

Minor Roof Repairs

Replace damaged shingles, seal roof penetrations, and address minor leaks and maintenance needs.

Screen Porch Repair

Repair damaged screens, doors, trim, and framing to restore your porch's appearance and function.

Exterior Repairs & Maintenance

General repairs and maintenance for the exterior of your home.

Pressure Washing

Clean siding, decks, patios, driveways, and walkways.

Deck Repair

Replace damaged boards, tighten railings, repair steps, and restore safe, sturdy decks.

Deck Staining

Professional preparation and staining of decks, railings, stairs, pergolas, and outdoor wood surfaces.
